Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::genereateApprovalLetter(id: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		loanRequest: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(o|o.RequestID = id),
		approvalLetter: ApprovalLetter = ApprovalLetter.allInstance()->any(o|o.Content = 'ApprovalLetterContent')
	precondition:
		loanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		let newApprovalLetter: ApprovalLetter in
		newApprovalLetter.oclIsNew() and
		ApprovalLetter.allInstance()->includes(newApprovalLetter) and
		loanRequest.AttachedApprovalLetter = newApprovalLetter and
		CurrentLoanRequest = loanRequest and
		newApprovalLetter.Content = 'ApprovalLetterContent' and
		result = true
}
